attendee_balance.heading: Reservation balance
attendee_balance.payment_link_descriptio: Send this secure link to the customer to collect the balance. It contains no personal details and is valid for about 90 days; generate a fresh one any time by reloading this page.
attendee_balance.offline_balance_message: No online payment link is available for this booking, so collect the balance directly from the customer. This figure is recorded here as a reminder of what is owed.
contact_history.title: Contact record
contact_history.description: Stats and private notes for one email or phone number, keyed by its anonymised HMAC. Saving overwrites the stored values — edit carefully to correct a contact's aggregated history.
contact_history.note_too_long: Notes must be {max} characters or fewer
attendee_form.send_email_to_attendee: Send an email to this attendee
attendee_form.no_email_disabled_title: This attendee has no email address on file
attendee_form.merge_attendee_description: Search for another attendee by their ticket token and merge their listing registrations into this attendee.
attendee_form.outstanding_balance_help: What the attendee still owes. Set to 0 when fully paid; the public payment link clears it automatically when they pay.
attendee_form.phone_pattern_title: Phone number (digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, optional leading +)
attendee_form.mixed_timings_warning: This attendee's existing daily listings have different start dates or lengths. Saving will put them all on the one date range above.
attendees_list.showing_count: {count, plural, one {Showing 1 attendee} other {Showing # attendees}} for
attendee_form.outstanding_balance_hint: What the attendee still owes. Set to 0 when fully paid; the public payment link clears it automatically when they pay.
attendee_form.balance_ledger_note: Changing the outstanding balance posts a correcting entry to the money ledger — the source of truth for what is owed. Corrections are appended, never destructive: only the difference from the current figure is recorded as a write-off adjustment.
attendee_form.phone_title: Phone number (digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, optional leading +)
attendee_form.dates_hint: Optional — the date only affects daily listings. A start date is required once you book a daily listing below.
attendee_form.availability_notice: Availability is inaccurate until dates have been saved.
attendee_form.error_no_lines: Book at least one listing before saving
attendee_form.error_built_site_no_qty: Unassign the built site from this booking before marking it no quantity.
attendee_form.error_paid_no_qty: Refund this booking's payment before marking it no quantity.
attendee_form.error_capacity: Not enough spots available for one or more selected listings — nothing was saved. Please review the quantities and try again.
attendee_form.warn_over_duration: {title} is designed for up to {max, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, but the booking spans {count}.
attendee_form.warn_overbooked: {title} is overbooked — there isn't capacity for {quantity} on these dates.
attendee_form.warn_incomplete_parent: {title} requires one of its child listings to be booked too ({children}) — public bookings choose one automatically; add it here.
attendee_form.paid_no_quantity_line: Refund this line's payment before marking it no quantity.
attendee_form.date_required: A start date is required for the booked daily listings
attendee_form.balance_paid_but_owes: This attendee is in a paid status but still owes {amount}.
attendee_form.balance_reservation_unpaid: This reservation has no balance recorded, but {amount} of the order is still unpaid.
attendee_form.balance_reservation_paid: This reservation is fully paid — consider moving it to a paid status.
